claims.text: Formed 24 June 1717 by four London lodges at the Goose and Gridiron; little known of Anthony Sayer; Anderson's Constitutions 1723 by order of the Grand Master, revised 1738; Prichard's Masonry Dissected (1730) gave 'a recognisable representation of all three degrees', and Grand Lodge changed ritual; union into UGLE 27 Dec 1813

William Morgan vanished 1826 in Batavia NY after arrest on flimsy charges, planned Illustrations of Masonry; never found; generally believed drowned in Niagara River, some argued he left; ten convicted, none more than three years; first presidential nominating convention Baltimore 1831; Wirt 7.8%, carried Vermont; absorbed into Whigs by 1840

entries.topic: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, "Freemasonry under the Nazi Regime"

claims.text: Heydrich counted Masons, Jews, political clergy among 'most implacable enemies'; 'Jewish-Masonic' conspiracy propaganda; summer 1934 lodges closed, libraries and archives confiscated; 28 Oct 1934 decree 'hostile to the state'; 17 Aug 1935 Frick ordered remaining lodges dissolved, assets confiscated; exhibitions Paris Oct 1940, Brussels Feb 1941; ERR seized archives 1942; numbers imprisoned solely as Masons unknown

sources.label: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum, "Freemasonry under the Nazi Regime"

claims.text: First appeared Strasbourg 1616; Andreae claimed authorship in his autobiography; divided into Seven Days paralleling the alchemical Great Work; invitation to a royal wedding at a castle; 'processions of tests, purifications, death, resurrection, and ascension'; alchemical romance tied to the Sacred Marriage

entries.topic: Grand Lodge of Illinois, "What is a 'Rough Ashlar'?"

claims.text: First degree; Entered Apprentice lecture: rough ashlar 'a stone in its rude and natural state, as taken from the quarry'; perfect ashlar 'one prepared by the workmen, to be adjusted by the working tools of a Fellow Craft'; refined by 'a virtuous education, our own endeavors, and the blessing of Deity'
